name: Japan Pulp & Paper Co Ltd
summary: Japan Pulp and Paper Company Limited, established in Tokyo, Japan in 1845, is a globally engaged enterprise specializing in the comprehensive lifecycle of paper, pulp, and related products. The company's extensive activities include the manufacturing, sourcing, distribution, and sale of a vast array of goods across international markets. Its core offerings span a diverse spectrum of paper and paperboard types, from household and processed papers to specialized capacitor and laminated papers, alongside containerboards, raw pulp, and materials for recycling. Beyond conventional paper items, the company also supplies crucial products such as paper films for electronic component production, various packaging solutions, inks, industrial chemicals, building materials, and electronic components. The firm's operations further encompass the provision of digital printers, various media, and harvesting equipment. Complementing its product sales, Japan Pulp and Paper delivers essential services including comprehensive warehousing, transportation, paper converting, cargo handling, efficient shipping pallet recovery, and business management support. Demonstrating a forward-thinking approach, the company is also a significant player in the information technology sector. This involves the sale of computer systems, software design and development, and internet retailing. Furthermore, it provides advanced enterprise AI solutions, application development tools, public cloud services, packaged software, information management solutions, and expert consulting on emerging technologies. Environmental stewardship is another vital facet of the company's endeavors. It actively recycles waste papers, plastics, and construction materials, transforming them into usable fuels. Additionally, Japan Pulp and Paper generates renewable energy through its wood fiber biomass and solar power generation facilities.
